mapper.select: SELECT user_id, consent_type, version, agreed, updated_at FROM consents WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY consent_type
SELECT user_id, consent_type, version, agreed, updated_at FROM consents WHERE updated_at >= #{from} AND updated_at < #{to} + 1 ORDER BY updated_at, user_id, consent_type
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO consents (user_id, consent_type, version, agreed, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{consentType}, #{version}, #{agreed}, #{updatedAt}) ON CONFLICT (user_id, consent_type) DO UPDATE SET version = EXCLUDED.version, agreed = EXCLUDED.agreed, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at
